highlights.title: Drop pictures into a message
highlights.line: Drag an image into the input, or paste a copied one, and it goes with your message.

highlights.title: Mac permissions in one place
highlights.line: Mewla asks for Screen Recording and Accessibility under one name, with a panel to drag in.

highlights.title: Pair your Mac from a link
highlights.line: Open a mewla:// link to pair, and Mewla moves to your local network by itself.

fixes: The counts at the top of the home tray stay on one line in a narrow column.
A reply from another computer reaches the Work or Brain chat you have open.
A code for a computer you already have, at a new address, asks first and names the host.
